column5: CLOSED 2026-08-05: vverify.skratch.tsv now records 9 match / 4 deferred / 0 partial. The two page frames (9003-142707 desktop, 9212-23847 mobile) and the chosen tablet frame (9003-148466) were partial only because /play/scratchers was unwired; Skai-Trading f0c229e1e wired it and all three are now screenshotted end to end on the live route at 1440/768/375. REAL-DATA FIX SHIPPED: the paytable strip's six chips were ordered money·star·slot·trophy·clover·gem, read off the chips' generic node names (Group 295…Group 305) rather than their art. Re-read from the RENDERED strip at all three scales (desktop 9212:21235, tablet 9058:2158, mobile 9212:25292) the designer's order is trophy·money·slot·star·clover·gem at every scale — which is also ascending by the real server multiplier 5·6·12·25·75·250 — so slots 0/1/3 were wrong; corrected in ScratchCardPro.tsx and verified live reading 5x 6x 12x 25x 75x 250x. Figma prints 1.98x on all six chips (one placeholder repeated); the real SCRATCH_PAYOUTS values are shown instead, and 7️⃣/🍒/🔔 pay ZERO by design so they are correctly absent from the strip. SECOND REAL-DATA FIX: the local-dev settlement mock in modules/skai-gaming/src/services/gaming/gameSettlementService.ts carried the RETIRED pre-retune scratch table (💎100 🍀25 ⭐10 🎰5 💰3 🏆2 and 7️⃣1.5 🍒1 🔔0.5) behind a "MUST MATCH edge function" comment, drawn from a UNIFORM 1-in-9 roll and read with `|| 1` — the exact trap paytables.ts warns about, which pays every zero-symbol 1x. Re-synced to the live table + SCRATCH_WEIGHTS with `?? 0`; dev-only path, never reachable in prod. NOTE CORRECTED: 9003-139146 is the AUTO/Advanced-OFF panel, not Manual — the true Manual panel frame is 9058-2367, mis-filed under the hilo section. The 4 deferred are 9003-149392 (the second, NOT-chosen 768 frame), 9220-26119 (region-restriction modal — the app already implements region denial in src/components/auth/GeoRestrictedRoute.tsx and a second competing modal on one concern was declined; copy preserved in scratchersPageContent.ts as SCRATCHERS_REGION_MODAL_DEFERRED) and 9220-26173 / 9220-26174 (pasted reference SCREENSHOTS, not design frames — nothing to implement). ★ RE-FILING RECOMMENDED: three frames currently under section `hilo` are Scratchers' and should move to `skratch` — 9058-1833 (the tablet board: 326 card frame, 3x3 at cell 87.5436 / gap 10.5613, six-across 653 Match-3-to-Win strip; ratios pad/frame 0.06479, gap/cell 0.12064, art/cell 0.67828 are IDENTICAL to the built scratchersTheme.ts BOARD_RATIO), 9058-2367 (the 356x621 MANUAL bet panel) and 9058-5154 (a third Scratchers tablet page, 768x1607, carrying the same Coinflip-panel designer error as 9003-148466/9003-149392). All three are already covered by the shipped responsive components — no new build needed. DECLINED: 9058-4372, whose Figma title also reads "Scratchers", is NOT Scratchers — its board and panel are Hi-Lo's (Profit Higher/Lower, King Being The Highest / Ace Being The Lowest, Higher-or-Same 30.77% / Lower-or-Same 76.92%, Start Card) and its blurb is Hi-Lo's; only its breadcrumb and info-card strings say Scratchers. It belongs in `hilo`.
